Tum sab ghatnaon ko control nahi kar sakte, lekin tum apni reaction decide kar sakte ho.
Strength jeet se nahi aati—struggles tumhari strength banate.
Saat baar girna, aathvi baar khada hona.
Sabse badi shaan girna nahi, balki har girne par khada hona hai.
Kabhi kabhi best answer: silence.
Khamoshi shaktishali gyaan hai.
Grit har rukawat paar karti hai.
Shaant dimag mein gehra grit hota hai.
Duniya todti hai, phir bhi kai strong bante.
Aage badhte raho.
Safalta antim nahi hai, vipalta ghatak nahi hai: aage badhte rehne ka saahas hi maayne rakhta hai.
Silence wisdom ka companion hai.
Silence pressure ko clarity banata.
Bahadur insaan kabhi akela nahi hota.
Khamoshi ek tarah ki resistance hai.
Himmat pehli insani khoobi hai.
Khamoshi sanctuary hai.
Khamosh dimag wars jeet sakte hain.
